rows.grounds: compound gerund: śuddha+agni (pure-fire, gen.) + bhāga (portion, acc.) + ādāya (having taken, √dā with ā)
sthāpayet = one should place (causative optative); pṛthak = separately (indeclinable)
athavā = or (indeclinable); agneḥ = from the fire (ablative singular)
compound gerund: vāma (left) + prāṇa (breath, instrumental sense in compound) + ādāya (having taken, √dā with ā)
compound/mantra term: hṛd (heart) + juṣ (pleasing/used with), instrumental singular; glossed as with heart-mantra
